query: Please implement an online photo gallery system for displaying and managing pictures. The system should have functionalities for uploading, deleting, editing, and categorizing. Users should be able to log in, browse, upload, and manage their own pictures, create albums, edit picture information, and share albums with other users. Declare old lace as the global background color and tan for all UI pieces.
